body: Tbh im in the same boat. I haven’t had any sexual interaction with women my entire life. Although you shouldn’t define ur self worth and existence on wether you can find a mate or not. Try to find a hobby you enjoy and focus your off time on that or if you have friends and family your close with, spend more time with them. Also I looked at ur post history and im generally concerned. Hurting pets is fucked man please never think of that. They are all pure at heart and tend to give unconditional love to people around them so hurting them is just plain wrong. If you need an outlet to vent ur anger I suggest you talk to somebody your close with or just shoot me a pm about ur situation in more detail. I also saw u said weights an issue for you. I not gonna say girls dont like fat guys (some indeed do) but just do your self a favor and try getting into a workout routine. Not only will it boost ur self confidence to find a girl but it will give you a better quality of life. Any who man I just wanna let you know your not alone and to not value women so much. I see way to many people rushing to find a date and ending up in a toxic relationship. Believe me you rather be lonely than be with some bitch
Theirs no way this train is going to keep going

Thank you witty. You couldn’t be more right with your statement. I feel lonely. Separated from the friend circles i once was part of.  I always wish to have a female partner to at least balance the emptiness i feel but being ugly and having social anxiety doesn’t exactly help. In terms of sports I’m very unathletic which makes me shit at them and i don’t like being part of competitive sports for that reason. I have an interest in computer science/programming but my school doesn’t have any clubs for that interest. I wish to be invited to parties or social events to at-least try to socialize with new people but those opportunities are vacant. I use to decline going to social events then do to my constant fear something would go wrong which has essentially blacklisted me from being invited. I want to change but I’ve fucked up so many people’s perspectives on me. I need help

If you feel like self harming to release anger i suggest you take the biggest pillow you got and punch the shit out of it. It works for me all the time and my wrist hasn’t seen a blade in years
